title: 0s and 1s
statement: The task is to find the minimum number of root pulses, modulo 998244353, that turn a tree's binary states x into targets y (n up to 2·10^5), or report -1. A pulse sets a 0 node to 1 and stops, or clears a 1 node and passes to every child. Each root-to-node path is a binary counter: depth d fixes bit d, and every node on that level must agree.
